reborn-0001.rationale: Backs to the Wall has a real current TCG-vs-OCG rules divergence. Current official TCG English text blocks a Graveyard Six Samurai only when the activating player already controls a monster with that same name. Current official Japanese OCG wording/Q&A applies the same-name prohibition to a same-name card on either player's field, and the pinned Project Ignis Lua follows that OCG behavior by searching both players' full on-field locations. Reborn uses current TCG text as authority. The reviewed override narrows only the duplicate-name gate to a face-up same-name monster in the activating player's Monster Zone, while preserving the leave-100-LP cost, different-name restriction within the same resolution, Special Summon capacity handling, and all other upstream behavior. This review certifies only the exact corrected executable script.

note: Script-hash-bound TCG-specific implementation review for Backs to the Wall's duplicate-name restriction.
